item.title: Discovering Facebook
item.description:
I recently came across Facebook — an online social networking site that’s quickly changing how people connect on the web.
www.facebook.com

Facebook lets users connect with friends, share updates, upload unlimited photos, and exchange links and videos. It’s more than just a profile — it’s a growing digital community where people stay in touch and discover more about one another.

The platform was created by Mark Zuckerberg and Chris Hughes in February 2004, originally as a private network for Harvard students. Within months, it expanded across other Ivy League schools, and by the end of that year, Facebook had already reached over a million users.
